items.question: How long is an International Driving Permit (IDP) issued in the UAE valid?
items.fact: UAE International Driving Permit is valid for one year

items.question: What documents are required to apply for an International Driving Permit (IDP) in the UAE?
items.gold: An IDL form, a copy of Emirates ID, a copy of passport and valid residency, a copy of valid UAE driving licence, and two passport-size photos.
items.fact: IDP application requires five listed documents and photos
